messages:
Emma: Heads-up  Quick plan for benchmark launch pages + webinar. Need: keyword targets, JSON-LD, redirect map (legacy & beta), internal link list, and UTM defaults. Who can pick pieces up?
Luis: I can do keyword mapping for 4 pages (landing, webinar, benchmarks hub, resources). Suggest keyword sets: landing = [low-latency inference, inference platform], webinar = [benchmark webinar, inference throughput benchmarks], benchmarks hub = [inference benchmarks, cost per token], resources = [inference whitepaper, production inference best practices].
Maya: Ill author meta titles/descriptions and the JSON-LD for Event + Organization. Will keep titles < 60 chars and add description variations for A/B.
Chris: Ill own webinar CTAs and the email UTM templates. Proposed UTM: utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=bench-launch-2026, utm_content=cta-button. Also need conversion event for GA4.
Ava: Ill sketch the internal linking plan. Priority links: /docs/perf-tuning -> landing, /benchmarks -> bench hub, /pricing/dedicated -> landing. Add breadcrumb trail on bench hub.
Oliver: Ill implement redirects. Need list of legacy paths. Example nginx redirect: ```rewrite ^/beta/bench$ /benchmarks/2026 permanent;``` Will add canonical headers and HSTS.
Luis: Draft redirects (will push to repo): ```# redirects-list
/old-benchmarks -> /benchmarks/2026 301
/beta/bench -> /benchmarks/2026 301
/legacy/benchmarks-index -> /benchmarks 301
/old-resources/whitepaper -> /resources/redwood-inference-whitepaper-2026 301
/events/bench-2025 -> /webinars/bench-launch 301
/old-landing -> /bench-launch 301```
Maya: JSON-LD snippet to insert in <head> (will validate with Rich Results): ```{ "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "Event", "name": "Redwood Benchmark Launch", "startDate": "2026-04-05T16:00:00Z", "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled", "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.com/webinars/bench-launch" }, "organizer": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference", "url": "https://redwood.com" } }```
Zoe: Ill wire up server-side logging to capture both 301 and 302 redirects, and create a GA4 conversion mapping for webinar signups. Also recommend tagging redirect PRs with "redirects/auto" label so SRE can review fast.
Chris: One more ask  redirect smoke test page: add /redirect-check that returns a small JSON listing status for a set of paths. Could be used by QA automation.
Oliver: Good idea. Ill add a simple route returning 200 + JSON in infra. Also will include wildcard redirect for legacy subdomain: ```server_name ~^legacy\\.redwood\\.com$; return 301 https://redwood.com$request_uri;```
Emma: Owner list: Luis = keywords + redirects list, Maya = meta + schema, Oliver = infra + deploy, Ava = internal linking, Chris = webinar copy + UTMs, Zoe = analytics & logging. Aim: draft PRs by Thursday EOD, full deploy Friday morning.
Luis: Will open keyword mapping PR today and include redirect CSV.
Maya: Will push meta + schema PR and run rich results test.
Ava: Will produce internal link map (CSV) and map anchor text recommendations.
Zoe: Ill add GA4 events and server-side logs; will run smoke test after deploy.
Oliver: Draft PR up: https://git.redwood.com/r/infrastructure/pulls/204. Please review.
Chris: Reviewed and left comments on CTA copy. Small nit: add aria-label to CTA on webinar page.
Emma: Thanks team. Friday 9:30am quick check to run redirect smoke test + analytics verification. :rocket:
